summary.answer_summary: The Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) under the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA) is operated jointly by the Central and State/UT Governments. summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that safety is accorded high priority on Indian Railways. The number of consequential train accidents has reduced from 135 in 2014-15 to 31 in 2024-25. In the Mumbai Suburban Railway Network, there were no fatalities or injuries in five consequential train accidents that occurred between 2020-21 and 2024-25. The causes of these accidents include track defects, loco/coach defects, equipment failures, human errors, etc. Accident victims are paid ex-gratia relief soon after an accident. Total amount of ex-gratia paid by the Railways to next of kin is Rs. 34.55 Lakh. Compensation for death/injury is decided by Railway Claims Tribunal (RCT) and total compensation paid is Rs. 216.87 Cr.
summary.overall_summary: The Minister states that safety is a high priority on Indian Railways, with consequential train accidents reducing from 135 in 2014-15 to 31 in 2024-25. In the Mumbai Suburban Railway Network, there were no fatalities or injuries in five consequential train accidents between 2020-21 and 2024-25. The causes of these accidents include track defects, loco/coach defects, equipment failures, human errors, etc. Accident victims are paid ex-gratia relief soon after an accident. Compensation for death/injury is decided by Railway Claims Tribunal (RCT) and total compensation paid is Rs. 216.87 Cr.

summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about a data breach by Star Health and Allied Insurance that led to sensitive personal information being shared on Telegram. summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERTIn) received a report about the data breach in August 2024. CERT-In notified the affected organization and coordinated incident response measures. The government remains aware of cyber threats and challenges, including those in the insurance sector. Measures taken to strengthen cybersecurity include designating CERT-In as the national agency for responding to cyber security incidents, implementing National Cyber Coordination Centre (NCCC) project, conducting regular training workshops, operating an automated cyber threat intelligence exchange platform, and conducting cyber security mock drills.

CERT-In received the report in August 2024 and notified the affected organization along with remedial actions to be taken. The government remains aware of cyber threats and challenges, including those in the insurance sector. Measures have been taken to strengthen cybersecurity, such as designating CERT-In as the national agency for responding to cyber security incidents, implementing National Cyber Coordination Centre (NCCC) project, conducting regular training workshops, operating an automated cyber threat intelligence exchange platform, and conducting cyber security mock drills.

summary.asked_by: Dr. L. Mugun: Minister of Information and Broadcasting, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary.question_summary: The MP asks about the progress made by the government since 2014 to strengthen communication, broadcasting, and digital governance. summary.question_summary: The question is about the Global Earth Observation System of Systems (GEOSS) 2025, which was held in New Delhi. The MP asks for information on the participation of international organizations and countries, the theme of the event, and the outcome of the meeting.

summary.overall_summary: The GEOSS-2025 meeting was a successful event organized by IAG with the support of ISRO, ASI, and other international organizations. summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about the estimated losses to Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) due to natural disasters during the last five years. He also wants information on the length of new railway lines constructed in the North Eastern Region (NER) during the same period, and whether any studies have been conducted on how construction can contribute to natural disasters like landslides.
summary.answered_by: The Minister of Railways; Minister of Information and Broadcasting; And Minister of Electronics and Information Technology (Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw)
summary.answer_summary: Railway projects are surveyed/sanctioned/executed Zonal Railway wise and not Region-wise/State-wise/UT-wise/District-wise. As of April 1, 2025, 12 railway projects have been sanctioned in the North Eastern Region (NER), out of which 278 km has been commissioned. The average budget allocation for infrastructure projects and other works is ₹2,122 crore/year. Indian Railways undertakes environmental initiatives like tree plantation, with over 9 lakh saplings planted by Northeast Frontier Railway during the last five years.
summary.overall_summary: The Minister provides information on railway projects in the North Eastern Region (NER), including sanctioned and commissioned projects, budget allocation, and environmental initiatives. The region is prone to natural disasters like landslides, and Indian Railways has undertaken studies and assessments of the environmental and geological impact of railway construction. Measures have been taken to mitigate risks, such as slope stabilization measures, plantation of grass and shrubs on slopes, and construction of catch drains and check dams.

summary.question_summary: The MP asks whether the Government plans to emphasize combining solar energy with Long Duration Energy Storage (LDES) to ensure continuous, reliable, and affordable renewable energy. The question also seeks details on this proposal or reasons why it may not be pursued.
summary.answered_by: THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF POWER; AND MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY (SHRI SHRIPAD YESSO NAIK)
summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that renewable power from wind and solar is variable and intermittent in nature. To address this, the Government has taken measures to promote Energy Storage Systems including LDES. These measures include publishing a National Framework for promoting energy storage systems, granting waivers on Inter-State Transmission System charges, approving Viability Gap Funding, and issuing an advisory on co-locating energy storage systems with solar power projects.
summary.overall_summary: The Minister highlights the importance of Long Duration Energy Storage (LDES) in enhancing grid stability by addressing intermittency and variability. The Government has taken several measures to promote energy storage systems including LDES, such as publishing a National Framework, granting waivers on Inter-State Transmission System charges, approving Viability Gap Funding, and issuing an advisory on co-locating energy storage systems with solar power projects.

summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about measures taken by the Government for modernizing Akashvani (All India Radio) and Doordarshan Kendras across the country, including those in Bihar. summary.overall_summary: The Government has taken measures to modernize and expand public broadcasting infrastructure across the country, including in Bihar. For Bihar specifically, projects worth Rs. 64.56 crore for Akashvani Kendras and Rs. 4.31 crore for Doordarshan Kendras have been sanctioned.

summary.asked_by: Shri Jashubhai Bhilubhai Rathva, Dr. Rajesh Mishra, Shri Damodar Agrawal, Shri Bibhu Prasad Tarai, and Shri Naba Charan Majhi
summary.question_summary: The MPs are asking about the BioE3 Biotechnology Policy, its objectives and features, and how it is helping India take a leadership role in biotechnology research and innovation. They also want to know about experiments conducted on microalgae and blue-green algae like Spirulina and Synechococcus, their role in space nutrition, oxygen production, and waste recycling. Additionally, they are asking about the significance of the Department of Biotechnology - International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) recently inaugurated in New Delhi and how it contributes to the Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle.

summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that the BioE3 policy aims to augment innovation-driven support to R&D and entrepreneurship, accelerate technology development and commercialization, and promote sustainable and circular practices. The policy is enabling industrialization of biology to address societal issues like climate change mitigation, food security, and human health. The experiments on microalgae and blue-green algae were conducted on the International Space Station (ISS) to study their growth in space and on Earth. The ICGEB Biofoundry will serve as a hub for interdisciplinary collaborations, research, and development in microbial biomanufacturing.
summary.overall_summary: The BioE3 policy aims to promote innovation-driven support to R&D and entrepreneurship, accelerate technology development and commercialization, and address societal issues like climate change mitigation, food security, and human health. The experiments on microalgae and blue-green algae were conducted on the ISS to study their growth in space and on Earth. The ICGEB Biofoundry will serve as a hub for interdisciplinary collaborations, research, and development in microbial biomanufacturing.

summary.asked_by: Ministry of Rural Development and Ministry of Communications
summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about the measures taken by the government to reduce call drops in rural areas. The question highlights that mobile usage has increased significantly in the country, but there are still issues with call drops and poor network quality. The MP wants to know what steps have been taken by the government to address these concerns.
summary.answered_by: Dr. Chandrasekhar Pemmaraju, Minister for Communications
summary.answer_summary: All telecom service providers (TSPs) have ensured that their services meet the average standards for call drop rates as per the PMOPAR report. To improve service quality, the government has implemented several measures such as: i) revising the criteria for determining service quality; ii) auctioning off mobile spectrum to TSPs; iii) simplifying the process of obtaining permission from the SSAC (Radio Frequency Allocation Advisory Committee); iv) launching a new website for ROF (Radio Frequency Allocation and Planning) and v) allowing TSPs to share infrastructure among themselves. The Minister also mentions that TSPI has been able to improve its network quality by upgrading its existing infrastructure.
summary.overall_summary: The government has taken several measures to address the issue of call drops in rural areas, including revising service quality criteria, auctioning off mobile spectrum, simplifying permission processes, and launching a new website for ROF. The Minister also highlights that TSPI has been able to improve its network quality by upgrading its existing infrastructure.

summary.question_summary: The MP asks about the re-engagement of retired railway employees against vacant non-gazetted posts. He also inquires if Divisional Railway Managers are empowered to appoint them on a contract basis as volunteers and if human error due to staff shortage was the major cause of train accidents during the last few years.

summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that occurrence and filling up of vacancies is a continuous process on Indian Railways, considering its size, spatial distribution, and criticality of operation. The railways fill vacancies primarily by placing indents with recruitment agencies as per operational and technological requirements. Recruitment done in Indian Railways during 2004-2014 vis-à-vis during 2014-2024 is given. The Minister also mentions the introduction of an annual calendar for recruitment to various categories of Group 'C' posts, which will benefit aspirants by providing more opportunities, certainty of exams, and a faster recruitment process.
summary.overall_summary: The Indian Railways has taken steps to fill vacant non-gazetted posts through a continuous process. The railways primarily place indents with recruitment agencies as per operational and technological requirements. Recruitment done in Indian Railways during 2004-2014 vis-à-vis during 2014-2024 is given. An annual calendar for recruitment has been introduced to benefit aspirants by providing more opportunities, certainty of exams, and a faster recruitment process.

summary.ministry: ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY
summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about the impact of US restrictions on AI hardware exports on India's AI development and related industries. Specifically, he wants to know if the government is aware of these regulations, which categorize India under Tier 2, restricting the import of high-performance computing GPUs. He also asks what steps are being taken by the government to ensure that these regulations do not hinder India's AI initiatives.
summary.answered_by: The Minister of State in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry; and Minister of State in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Shri Jitin Prasada)
summary.answer_summary: The Minister responds that on January 15th, 2025, the US Department of Commerce issued an AI Diffusion Rule providing for export control and licensing regulations. However, this rule was rescinded on May 13th, 2025. The government is committed to democratizing technology and has launched the IndiaAI mission in March 2024, which aims to establish a robust and inclusive AI ecosystem aligned with India's development goals.
summary.overall_summary: The US restrictions on AI hardware exports may have an impact on India's AI development, but since the rule was rescinded, this issue is no longer relevant. The Indian government has launched the IndiaAI mission to position India as a global leader in artificial intelligence and ensure that these regulations do not hinder its initiatives.

summary.overall_summary: The government has taken several steps to improve the public distribution system (PDS) in India, including digitization of ration cards, online allocation of rations, and implementation of a unique identification number for each beneficiary. summary.ministry: Prime Minister's Office; Ministry of Science and Technology; Ministry of Earth Sciences; Department of Atomic Energy; Department of Space
summary.question_summary: The MP asks about the status of Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (NVS) satellites, specifically NVS-03, NVS-04, and NVS-05. He also inquires about the number of trains equipped with NavIC technology for real-time tracking.

summary.question_summary: The MP is asking about the current status of India's cloud seeding capabilities, including research, technology, and operational readiness. Additionally, he asks if studies have been conducted on the environmental and health hazards of cloud seeding and whether cloud seeding-induced rainfall can help reduce air pollution.
summary.answer_summary: The Minister states that the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) under the Ministry of Earth Sciences had conducted a research study named Cloud Aerosol Interaction and Precipitation Enhancement Experiment (CAIPEEX) during 2018-2019. The CAIPEEX study was carried out using specially hired cloud seeding and research aircraft over the rain shadow region of the Indian peninsula. The study has drawn guidelines for conducting cloud seeding over the rain shadow region. IITM has developed knowledge and expertise in the subject, and operational readiness is hindered by not having the necessary aircraft at disposal and associated permissions required to operate.
summary.overall_summary: The Minister provides information on India's current status of cloud seeding capabilities, including research, technology, and operational readiness. The Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) had conducted a research study named Cloud Aerosol Interaction and Precipitation Enhancement Experiment (CAIPEEX) during 2018-2019 to investigate aerosol-cloud-precipitation interaction and conduct randomized cloud seeding tests. The report was released publicly, showing that rainfall can be enhanced by up to 46% at some locations. Potential applications of cloud seeding include targeted weather modification aspects such as fog suppression, hail suppression, marine cloud brightening, etc.
